preview_summary: Help us learn about how the auditory environment affects preschool children! In this study, your child will play a sorting game while listening to background noise.
short_description:
In this study, your child will meet Collin, a child who wants to go outside and play, but must clean his room first. Collin will ask your child for help! Your child will first learn how Collin wants his toys to be sorted into 2 boxes while listening to background noise. Your child will then sort toy animals and vehicles into the boxes based on Collin's sorting rules with no background noise.

Please note: The background noise may be bothersome for children who are sensitive to sound.
purpose: If you have ever tried working on a difficult or time-intensive task in a noisy environment, you have probably found the noise to be distracting, and it may have even taken you longer to finish! There is some research that shows the same is true for children, and possibly with even more disruption. This study is meant to understand how the timing of background noise affects preschool children's ability to complete thinking tasks like sorting. If the timing of background noise does impact thinking task performance, this could tell us which every day environments support learning and which are more challenging for young children.
compensation: To thank you for your participation, you will receive a $5 Amazon.com gift card within 2 weeks of your participation. To be eligible for the gift card, your child must be in the age range for the study, you need to provide a valid consent statement, we need to see that there is a child with you in the video, and this needs to be the first time that your child is participating in this study.
